parallel.requirements: Recognized the C++ to Rust port, zero dependencies, Rust 2021/Cargo layout, root test1.rs entry, both build paths, stoi parity, and persistent vector performance requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Chose a workflow with two recon children, three independent implementation candidates, one diff-test per candidate, three judges, finalization, five skeptics, repair, and critic stages.
parallel.implementation: No completed implementation candidate is visible; the implementation children repeatedly reached only setup and reference-binary checks before interruption or killed closure.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The script reserved /output for a later finalize phase, but the workflow never reached finalization, so artifact validation found an empty output directory.
parallel.verification: Recon verified substantial ground truth, but candidate diff testing, judges, final verification, repair, and critic stages did not run to completion.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow was killed with implementation agents still in progress after retry stalls; no /output files or final response were produced, and the evaluator passed 0 of 38 tests.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same task requirements: persistent structurally shared vector, std-only Rust, C++ stoi behavior, root test1.rs, Cargo build, rustc build, and byte-exact CLI behavior.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked as a single direct implementer in /output, keeping implementation, fix, build, verification, and final delivery under one local control flow.
serial.implementation: Created Cargo.toml, test1.rs, src/immer modules, and cpp_compat stoi modules; fixed a trie new_path off-by-one found by tests.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Built and left both /output/test1 and target/release/test1 plus source files in the artifact tree accepted by artifact validation.
serial.verification: Ran cargo build, cargo test, rustc build, edge-case differentials, a byte-exact sweep, dependency audit, and performance checks before final response.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No official unresolved defect remained; the final evaluator accepted the artifact with 38 of 38 passing tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel identified extensive required behavior, including stoi quirks, output bytes, build paths, and persistent-vector performance.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial identified the same behavioral and build requirements through direct probing before implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement recognition was not the differentiator; serial converted the requirements into a delivered project while parallel stopped before implementation delivery.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into many workflow stages and three separate implementation candidates.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial control had workflows disabled and used one direct implementation path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel distributed ownership broadly and created a long dependency chain; serial kept all implementation, fixing, and delivery obligations with the main actor.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel briefs gave implementers the recon findings, directory isolation, build layout, and acceptance checks.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained the task context in one local trajectory while writing the module files directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No missing brief or interface-contract defect explains the result; the context was sufficiently specified but the parallel pipeline did not complete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implementation children only started/restarted and ran setup or reference checks; no candidate implementation result appears.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the Rust project, then edited node.rs to fix the trie path bug discovered by tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial produced and corrected source code; parallel had no completed source implementation to integrate.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel workflow state ended killed with implementation agents still in progress and no aggregate result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial carried its own intermediate build/test results through to a final response and artifact tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had no completed implementation result to join; serial kept the local result lifecycle closed through final verification.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel isolated candidate writes in /tmp/candN and reserved /output for a later finalize phase that never ran.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the final project directly in /output and artifact validation listed the expected files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no write collision; the key difference is that serial populated the final tree, while parallel never reached the final tree write.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel planned independent diff tests, judges, skeptics, repair, and critic stages after implementations.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran tests after the fix, then final differential and dependency audits before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification stages were planned but not reached; serial performed evaluator-aligned verification on the delivered artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the 2400-second run with workflow retries and was killed with no final result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed in about 915 agent seconds with remaining provider budget and a successful official evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The budget/closure difference is decisive: parallel spent its window before implementation and finalization, while serial finished with verified files.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is discordant because the parallel workflow never delivered an artifact: it was killed after recon and repeated implementation retries, leaving /output empty and scoring 0/38. The serial run wrote the Rust project directly in /output, fixed a test-discovered trie bug, rebuilt, differentially tested, and delivered the files accepted by artifact validation, scoring 38/38.
parallel_contributors: Workflow fan-out scheduled three full candidate implementations plus diff testing, judges, finalization, skeptics, repair, and critic stages.
Implementation children stalled and retried; the workflow was killed before any implementation candidate, diff-test result, or finalization result returned.
Because /output was reserved for a later finalization phase, artifact collection saw no files.
serial_contributors: Serial implemented the Cargo project directly in /output instead of waiting for separate candidates and judges.
Serial fixed the trie new_path bug after unit tests and re-ran build, tests, differential checks, and dependency audit.
Serial artifact validation found the expected source and executable files, and the official evaluator passed all 38 tests.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The only concrete implementation bug observed in serial was repaired before delivery; parallel produced no completed implementation for code-level comparison.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause
